---
title: "Current-catalogue viral community composition"
format: html
---

Reuses the 634-vOTU catalogue underlying the current abundance analysis. No
significance filter, low-abundance exclusion or rarefaction is applied.

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
source("R/figure_style.R")
out <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[1]
plot_height <- if(length(commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE))>1) as.numeric(commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[2]) else 5.5
stopifnot(!is.na(out),!dir.exists(out))
dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
d <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
countfile <- file.path(d,"community_cycle_models_catalogue_aligned_2026-09-16-v1/tables/votu_counts.tsv")
taxfile <- file.path(d,"votu_taxonomic_resolution_review_2026-09-13-v4/tables/catalogue_rank_assignments.tsv")
c <- fread(countfile); t <- fread(taxfile)
stopifnot(nrow(c)==634,nrow(t)==634,!anyDuplicated(c$feature_id),!anyDuplicated(t$contig_id),setequal(c$feature_id,t$contig_id))
x <- melt(c,id.vars="feature_id",variable.name="sample",value.name="reads")
x <- merge(x,t[,.(feature_id=contig_id,realm)],by="feature_id")
x[is.na(realm)|realm=="",realm:="Unclassified"]
stopifnot(all(x$realm %in% names(phage_uv_viral_realm_colours)),nrow(x)==634*12,all(x$reads>=0))
x[,condition:=factor(ifelse(grepl("^control",sample),"Control","Treatment"),levels=c("Control","Treatment"))]
x[,cycle:=as.integer(sub(".*cycle","",sample))]
x[,phase:=ifelse(grepl("_initial_",sample),"I","BF")]
x[,position:=factor(paste0("C",cycle,"-",phase),levels=as.vector(rbind(paste0("C",1:3,"-I"),paste0("C",1:3,"-BF"))))]
a <- x[,.(reads=sum(reads)),by=.(sample,condition,position,realm)]
a[,proportion:=reads/sum(reads),by=sample]
stopifnot(all(abs(a[,sum(proportion),by=sample]$V1-1)<1e-12))
p <- ggplot(a,aes(position,proportion,fill=realm))+geom_col(width=.58)+
 facet_grid(condition~.)+scale_fill_manual(values=phage_uv_viral_realm_colours,name="Viral realm")+
 scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::label_percent(),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.01)))+
 labs(x="Cleaning cycle and sampling phase",y="Relative abundance\n(vOTU-mapped MG reads)")+
 theme_classic(base_size=11)+theme(legend.position="bottom",strip.background=element_rect(fill="#f3f3f3",colour=NA),
 strip.text=element_text(size=11),axis.text.x=element_text(size=10))
ggsave(file.path(out,"votu-realm-composition.pdf"),p,width=7,height=plot_height,device=pdf,useDingbats=FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out,"votu-realm-composition.png"),p,width=7,height=plot_height,dpi=180,device=ragg::agg_png)
fwrite(a,file.path(out,"plotted_values.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("Relative abundance of the 634 catalogue vOTUs across the 12 metagenomic samples, grouped by viral realm.",
 "Control and Treatment are vertically aligned. I, initial; BF, backflush. Within each sample the denominator is the sum of reads assigned to all 634 catalogue vOTUs, not all sequenced reads.",
 "All vOTUs, including unclassified and low-abundance members, are retained. Colours use the shared viral-tree realm palette. No new hypothesis test was performed."),file.path(out,"CAPTION.txt"))
hash <- function(p) substr(system2("shasum",c("-a","256",shQuote(p)),stdout=TRUE)[1],1,64)
fwrite(data.table(path=c(countfile,taxfile),sha256=vapply(c(countfile,taxfile),hash,character(1))),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("PASS: 634 unique vOTUs; taxonomy IDs match; 12 samples; each sample sums to 100%; shared palette; no dropped taxa."),file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
```
